system.description:
All allies within 6 squares of you gain a +5 Force bonus on Skill Checks or Grapple checks made to escape Grapples or other Immobilizing Hazards.

Additionally, whenever an ally within 6 squares of you is moved against its will (such as by the Move Object Force Power or the Bantha Rush feat), you can spend a Force Point as a Reaction to negate the forced movement entirely.
